name: Sliding counter
summary: Two adjacent window counts, weighted by how far into the new window you are. Removes the boundary burst for three integers per key instead of a hundred timestamps.

complexity.space: O(k) for k keys, three integers each

notes: The estimate assumes the previous window's requests were spread evenly across it, so it errs low when they were front-loaded and high when they were back-loaded. The weighting is integer arithmetic with the remainder discarded, which keeps the three language ports deciding identically.
